safety_verdicts.content: Chest pain radiates to the shoulder and neck.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated includes radiation to left arm/shoulder but does not mention radiation to the neck.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting neck radiation slightly downplays a classic acute coronary syndrome feature and could reduce perceived acuity in documentation/handovers. However, the transcript clearly supports significant radiation to the left arm/shoulder and ongoing chest pressure, so overall triage urgency would likely remain high.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state haemodynamic stability.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document haemodynamic stability removes an important risk-stratification element in suspected MI and can impair the quality of escalation/handover to emergency services. In this case, an ambulance was already being arranged, so the omission is less likely to change immediate actions.
